messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT CREATED — high tail latency observed for streaming RPCs in eu-west-1. Auto-alert: p99 > 4s for 5m. Paging on-call.

alice: seeing a sharp p99 tail spike starting ~1798645200. p95 up a bit but p99 is the problem. Streaming stalls reported by a few customers (chunked responses hang). Telemetry shows a handful of router backends with huge queue depth.

bob: I’m on it — joining bridge. Can you paste the top router hosts?

alice: quick dump of hottest routers (from routing-telemetry):
```
HOT_BUCKETS:
- router-eu-b-07 : queue_depth=1245, avg_lat=420ms, p99=6.3s
- router-eu-b-02 : queue_depth=980, avg_lat=310ms, p99=5.9s
- router-eu-c-04 : queue_depth=45, avg_lat=50ms, p99=90ms
```
Notably two routers are overloaded while others look fine.

carol: that smells like a hotbucket (hash skew) or balancer eject policy flapping. Any recent routing policy rollouts in eu-west-1? @ellen — did your rollout finish earlier today?

ellen: we did a weighted routing rollout for canary traffic 3h ago, 1% -> 10%. No errors in the rollout job. I’ll check the config quickly.

alice: by eye the affected keys map to the same shard range. Also seeing a handful of misroutes where traffic for eu-west-1 gets routed to the same subset of routers repeatedly.

dave: support reports 3 paid customers with streaming interruptions. One filed a realtime session drop for ~30s; others saw high rebuffering.

bob: run quick sanity on balancer state. carol, can you grab lb debug?

carol: lb dump (truncated):
```
balancer-state eu-west-1:
- ring-seed: 0x7a2b
- active-pools: 12
- policy: WEIGHTED_BY_REGION (v3)
- pool-assignments: deterministic-hash
- last-config-change: 2026-03-14T09:12:03Z
```
Also seeing agent logs: repeated ejection (evict->rehash->readd) cycles for router-eu-b-07.

bob: if routers are being ejected and readded frequently, that can cause hotspots as the hash ring shifts. Mitigation: pause autoscale/ejection and pin traffic away from the bad nodes temporarily.

alice: initiating emergency mitigation: 1) pause ejection for eu-west-1, 2) add soft-redirect to fallback-pool (eu-west-fallback), 3) set ramp-down of weighted rollout to 0% (rollback). Doing steps now.

incident-bot: Action log: pause-ejection eu-west-1 by alice at 1798645405

carol: I see the pause hit lb-control-plane. Applying soft-redirect to fallback pool (will redirect 40% of new sessions away from primary ring).

alice: rollback of rollout posted to config service.

incident-bot: Action log: config-rollout-rollback eu-west-weighted-v3 by alice at 1798645422

bob: monitoring for p99 change. dashboards updated.

alice: quick tail after the soft redirect (2m after):
```
p95: 210ms -> 180ms
p99: 6.2s -> 1.1s
streaming stall reports: 3 -> 0
```
Looks like the redirect helped reduce tail.

dave: notified affected customers of temporary mitigation. Customer impact status: 3 customers impacted, degraded streaming for ~15-45s window for each. No data loss reported. CS escalation open.

ellen: follow-up: we should still find why ejection kept tripping. Uploading router-eu-b-07 agent heap/profile next.

carol: initial theory: weighted rollout interacted poorly with the eviction heuristic causing a cascading ejection of routers with cold caches (hotbucket concentrated keys). Will look at eviction thresholds and hash seeding.

bob: oncall handoff: alice -> bob in 15m. alice, anything outstanding you want me to own when you step off?

alice: take ownership of post-mortem, the root cause triage (routing policy + eviction heuristic), and follow-up customer comms. I’ll draft an RCA outline before I leave the bridge. Also verify no other regions show similar behavior.

bob: ack. I’ll keep monitoring and coordinate with carol on fix rollout. If p99 creeps above 2s again, we’ll consider scaling up capacity + pinning.

incident-bot: Bridge closed for initial mitigation at 1798645600 (status: degraded->stabilizing). Incident channel will remain open for follow-up.

alice: quick notes for the postmortem: timeline, symptoms, mitigation (pause eject, soft-redirect, rollback rollout), customer impact, follow-up tasks (hash seed audit, adjust eviction thresholds, add canary for ejection flapping). I’ll attach logs and the diff for the rollback.

dave: adding CS notes: SLO impact recorded, outreach in progress, update sent to billing for risk review.

carol: I’ll prepare a small patch to prevent ejection during weight rollouts (stop re-ejections on nodes added/removed for 2m window). Will send PR and a coordinated canary plan.

bob: thanks all. leaving a watch while alice signs off. :white_check_mark:

alice: thanks team. handing bridge to bob now. :wave:

bob: taking over — will update thread with any regressions or when RCA draft ready.

incident-bot: Incident resolved from PAGER -> MONITORED at 1798645620 (p99 back to <1.2s, customer streaming stable).
